payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy bottom-up removal of exactly k leaves attached to a node; when all leaves are removed, the node becomes a leaf and propagates upward. Stack processes nodes with >=k leaf children.
payload.rationale: The solution repeatedly removes groups of k leaves from nodes when available, which is optimal due to an exchange argument: removing leaves earlier cannot prevent later moves. The greedy choice is locally optimal and leads to global maximum.
